title: selaginella brasiliensis
intro: Selaginella brasiliensis, commonly known as Brazilian spikemoss, is a species of plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is a type of ancient, non-vascular cryptogam, which is a group of plants that reproduce via spores rather than seeds. The health benefits of Selaginella brasiliensis include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
